_comment: BELU3R arrival into LSGG runway 22 -- spoken BELUS THREE ROMEO. Chosen because the STAR ENDS IN A VECTORING TERMINATION: its last leg at GG512 is a CIFP 'FM' (course from fix, manual termination), i.e. the procedure hands the aircraft to radar vectors instead of joining an IAF. Arrival from the south-west (ARDEG), so the aircraft reaches the runway-22 axis from the left -- the left-hand vectoring pattern. Flown with ATC_FMS=1: the pilot follows the route the engine is tracking, so the STAR and the approach transition come from the real CIFP, not from a recorded track. [C. P. Potter]
